messages:
maya: FYI release v2.14.0 blocked, integration job failing since ~04:13. I think it's related to last night's cache namespace rotation.
jun: Which job? sending link — https://ci.internal/pipelines/1234 (integration-e2e #1234)
ci-bot: Build #1234 failed (exit 1). failing tests: tests/api_endpoints/test_upload.py::test_large_artifact
elaine: Storage logs show `artifact-store: checksum mismatch for blob 0x9f2a` during extractor step. Looks like wrong namespace used on restore.
sre-oncall: If rotation swapped namespaces, runners might be pulling stale keys. Change window ends in ~40m. Thoughts on quick mitigation?
maya: Prefer not to rollback the release itself. Can we pin the CI run to the old CACHE_NAMESPACE and re-run only the release branch?
jun: I pushed feature/ci-pin-cache with CACHE_NAMESPACE=ns-20260210-v1 into the pipeline config. Local repro: `bazel test //pkg/upload:test --test_output=errors` shows same extraction error when using ns-20260211-v2.
deploy-bot: Canary halted — canary-4 failed to start due to missing artifact digest. Rollouts paused automatically.
elaine: Runner logs: `tar: Unexpected EOF` on runner-7 during extraction. Artifact creation for ns-20260211-v2 looks partial.
maya: Options: A) Revert infra cache-rotation commit (fast) and re-run CI pinned to old namespace, or B) purge caches and rebuild artifacts (slower but clean).
jun: Can revert rotation commit 7a9c1f2 in infra. Revert will restore previous namespace immediately but any artifacts built with the new namespace might be orphaned.
sre-oncall: Given the change window, recommend short revert + targeted pipeline for the release branch. I'll open a change ticket and notify storage.
maya: @elaine can you L2 sign-off for in-window infra revert? We need ops approval to touch infra config.
elaine: :thumbsup: L2 approves. Jun, proceed and I'll monitor artifact integrity.
jun: Revert PR opened: infra#452. Command: `git revert --no-edit 7a9c1f2 && git push origin HEAD`.
ci-bot: infra PR infra#452 merged by jun at 1919876620. Infra CI started.
maya: Re-running release pipeline (v2.14.0) with pinned CACHE_NAMESPACE to ns-20260210-v1. Running smoke + integration-e2e only to save time.
ci-bot: Build #1235 started: integration-e2e on runner-9.
sre-oncall: If #1235 passes we'll lift the canary hold and continue rollout.
elaine: Tailing storage & artifact-service logs, no checksum errors so far for the re-run.
ci-bot: Build #1235 SUCCESS. integration-e2e passed.
maya: Good — canary resume approved. Will continue gradual rollout and close the change ticket after verification.
deploy-bot: Rollout resumed: canary-4 -> canary-5. Monitoring window 15m.
jun: Follow-up action: I'll add a postmortem note and update rotation scripts to lock namespace changes during active releases.
elaine: I'll schedule a backfill to reconcile orphaned blobs and run a consistency sweep on the artifact store.
sre-oncall: Closing incident when rollout metrics stable and no regression. Thanks all :pray:
